title: Zero Standing Secrets
space: the student's own namespace `students/{user}`, database `app_{user}`, repo `{user}/capstone` and capstone slot `{user}-capstone`
goal: Give your app slot a new app with no secret stored anywhere in git, CI or on disk: identity from the platform, its own least-privilege policy, one static secret and one dynamic credential, and prove a rotation with no deploy.
seed: `dojo-challenge start capstone` creates `{user}/capstone` (cloned to `~/lab/capstone`) with a brief and a starter `capstone/agent.hcl`; the names to use are policy `capstone-app`, platform role `capstone-app`, database role `capstone-app`, KV mount `capstone/` and secret `capstone/app`. Starting the capstone also unlocks the student's second app slot, `{user}-capstone` (platform identity `slot:{user}-capstone`): a push to `main` of `{user}/capstone` deploys there, and the app the labs left in `{user}` keeps running. The brief says so.
verify_text: Two steps. Step 1, in `students/{user}` (metadata only, never a value): policy `capstone-app` names only paths under `capstone/` and `database/creds/`, allows read of `capstone/data/app` and `database/creds/capstone-app`, and not of `secret/`; the `jwt-platform` role `capstone-app` carries that policy; database role `capstone-app` exists with a credential issued from it; `capstone/app` exists; `capstone/agent.hcl` in the student's repo holds no `role_id` or `secret_id`. Step 2, the rotation with no deploy: `capstone/app` has been written again since step 1 passed, and `main` of `{user}/capstone` has no commit newer than that (a push deploys; one sends the student back to step 1). Not checked: that the app shows the new value, and that the scanner passes.
isolation: namespace, database, repo and capstone slot are all the student's own; the checks read only `students/{user}` and `{user}/capstone`. It is safe for the whole class to run it at once. Each student's capstone slot stays locked (no identity, no deploys) until their `{user}/capstone` repo exists.
hints: Rotation is a write, not a deploy.

then.text: rotate `capstone/app` now (`bao kv put` or `bao kv patch` a new value) without pushing to `main` of your capstone repo; the Agent hands the app the new value with no deploy.

answer: `dojo-challenge start capstone`, then in `students/$USER`: enable `kv-v2` at `capstone`, write `capstone/app` (once now; the rotation comes after the first check), write policy `capstone-app` (read `capstone/data/app` and `database/creds/capstone-app`), a database role `capstone-app`, the `jwt-platform` role `capstone-app` with `bound_subject=slot:$USER-capstone` and `token_policies=capstone-app`, read `database/creds/capstone-app` once, keep `agent.hcl` free of any role or secret id, push, then `dojo-check capstone`; then, without pushing, `bao kv put capstone/app` a new value and `dojo-check capstone` again.
